fusions.name: Knocking Off Spalls
fusions.desc: Knocks 4 jagged spalls off a block in a spread, and each deals 2 damage.

fusions.name: Backfill
fusions.desc: Buries the target, which deals 24 damage, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Waymark Cairn
fusions.desc: After a 0.5-second cast, stacks a cairn for 10 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it throws a stone at an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 damage.

fusions.name: Bedrock Beneath Paving
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
